digest_rule: sha256 of the sorted lines: the path relative to the group's folder, a tab, the file's sha256, a line end

api_base.what: the spend file, the read fault file when there is one, the tries called for, the reserve state file, the read notice switch and the two gate markers

batches.what: every batch file and pending manifest

drive.what: the driver's logs and console printouts (an addition)

lane.what: the lane's pilot records and the scripts it wrote after note 2 (an addition)

later_bodies.what: every later-turn body and its continuation record (r1/ and r2/)

records.what: the rater ids file and, when there is one, the API stops file

results.what: every raw result, hashed by bytes only

scripts.what: the live scripts of the route, as they made and held these files (an addition to the plan's list)

rule: the plan's section 11, step 14: every answer, raw result, batch file, order, continuation record and spend file fixed by sha256 before any is parsed; with the records, the switches, the gate markers, the live scripts, the driver's logs and the lane's pilot records
